effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` cbBTC to the vault, spending their cbBTC allowance to the vault. The vault supplies it to Morpho Blue markets.
`receiver` gets newly minted MCcbBTC shares. The amount is assets converted at the vault's current share price (rounded down), so it is not in the calldata.
Before pricing, pending performance-fee shares are minted to the vault's feeRecipient (_accrueFee). This is set by storage.
formats.shown: The intent "Deposit" with owner MEV Capital, the cbBTC amount deposited, a constant 'Share ticker' MCcbBTC, and the address that receives the shares.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares received is computed from the vault price and is not shown.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. The calldata has no minShares, so no descriptor field can show the amount.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. A label like 'Shares sent to' already sets the expectation.

findings.title: deposit: the intent 'Deposit' names neither the amount, the asset nor the vault.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json deposit: "intent": "Deposit", no interpolatedIntent. The fields have assets (cbBTC) and receiver.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent "Deposit {assets} into MEV Capital cbBTC vault, shares to {receiver}" and intent "Deposit cbBTC".

effects: The signer pays cbBTC to the vault. The amount is `shares` converted at the vault's current share price (rounded up), read from storage and not from the calldata. This spends their cbBTC allowance.
Pending fee shares are minted to feeRecipient before pricing.
formats.shown: The intent "Mint", a 'Deposit asset' field that shows only the ticker cbBTC with no amount, the MCcbBTC shares minted, and the share receiver.

findings.title: mint: the cbBTC the signer pays is derived from the share price and its amount is never shown.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, assets, shares);`. Case 0: 101 CBBTC go out from the signer to the vault, and the screen shows only 'Deposit asset: cbBTC'. ERC-4626 mint has no maxAssets parameter that could bound it.
findings.fix: No field can carry the amount. Relabel the field as 'Pays (amount set by vault price)' so the signer knows the cost is computed.

findings.title: mint: the 'Deposit asset' field shows a bare ticker, which reads as a missing amount.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json mint field {"label":"Deposit asset","format":"raw","value":"$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}. Case 0 screen 'Deposit asset: cbBTC'. The reader wrote 'cbBTC, amount not shown' and listed 'How much cbBTC I will pay' as unsure.
findings.fix: Use intent 'Mint vault shares by paying cbBTC' and an interpolatedIntent "Mint {shares} to {receiver}, paying cbBTC at the vault price".

cases.notes: The signer paid 101 cbBTC sats. The screen shows the asset but not the amount. 999e9 MCcbBTC went to 0xdead as shown, and that is not the signer's.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: Exactly `assets` cbBTC is pulled from Morpho markets and sent to `receiver`.
`owner`'s MCcbBTC shares are burned. The number is assets converted at the vault price (rounded up), so it is not in the calldata.
If owner is not the signer, the signer's share allowance from owner is spent by that share amount.
Pending fee shares are minted to feeRecipient first.
formats.shown: The intent "Withdraw", the exact cbBTC amount withdrawn, the recipient, and the owner whose shares are used.

findings.title: withdraw: the shares burned from the owner are computed from the vault price and are not shown.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); _withdraw(_msgSender(), receiver, owner, assets, shares);`. There is no maxShares parameter.
findings.fix: Relabel 'Owner' as 'Shares burned from' so the share cost is implied.

findings.title: withdraw: the intent 'Withdraw' has no amount, asset or vault.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent "Withdraw {assets} from MEV Capital cbBTC vault to {receiver}".

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: Exactly `shares` MCcbBTC are burned from `owner`. If owner is not the signer, this spends the signer's allowance.
`receiver` gets cbBTC. The amount is shares converted at the vault price (rounded down), read from storage and not from the calldata.
Pending fee shares are minted to feeRecipient first.
formats.shown: The intent "Redeem", the MCcbBTC shares redeemed, the recipient, and the owner. Nothing names the asset received.

findings.title: redeem: the asset received (cbBTC) is never named, though the descriptor has it as a constant.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json redeem fields are only shares, receiver and owner. MetaMorpho.sol redeem → ERC4626._withdraw transfers the underlying asset to receiver. Case 1: 1053236 CBBTC in to the signer. The reader wrote 'Underlying asset (likely cbBTC)... Which token is the underlying; assumed cbBTC'.
findings.fix: Add a field {"label":"Receive asset","value":"$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"} as mint does, or name cbBTC in the intent.

findings.title: redeem: the cbBTC amount received is computed from the vault price and is not shown.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. There is no minAssets parameter. Case 1: 1053236 CBBTC in, not on the screen.

findings.title: redeem: the intent 'Redeem' names neither the shares, the vault nor what comes back.

cases.notes: The 0.0104 MCcbBTC out is shown right. The 1053236 cbBTC in has no amount on screen and its asset is not named either. The reader guessed cbBTC.
